name: PowerKing Turbo Power PK-60 120W Fast Charger
description: All-protocol 120W wall charger with a single USB-A port, supplied with a 100cm USB-A to Type-C cable. Input 110-220V; output 5V/3A, 9V/2.77A or 12V/2.08A. Carries overcurrent, overvoltage, short-circuit and temperature protection, and supports Turbo Charge, Super Fast, Dash, Flash Charge, Warp, SuperVOOC and Quick Charge 4.0 handsets.

name: PowerKing 1USB Multi Protocol Fast Charger 120W
description: Single-port 120W multi-protocol fast charger sold as a 2-in-1 pack with a USB data cable, combining data transfer and high-speed charging. Full output table is not printed on the box face photographed.

name: VGR V-091 Professional Hair Trimmer
description: Metal-bodied professional T-blade trimmer with an LED charge display and a 600mAh battery, usable corded or cordless and charged over USB. Supplied with guide combs, a cleaning brush, blade oil, a charging cable and a manual.

name: VGR V-071 Professional Hair Trimmer
description: Chrome-finish professional hair trimmer for corded or cordless use, charged over USB at 5V/1A. Supplied with 1mm, 2mm and 3mm guide combs, a cleaning brush, blade oil, a USB-C cable and a storage pouch.

name: VGR Super Trim 14-in-1 Grooming Kit
description: Fourteen-piece grooming set built around a rechargeable trimmer with an LED display, rated IPX6 for washing. Includes clipper, nose-trimmer and shaver heads, four guide combs, a charging dock, a USB cable and a cleaning brush. [CONFIRM MODEL NUMBER — not legible in the photograph]

name: NeePho NP-888 2-in-1 Phone Tripod
description: Extendable aluminium tripod with a spring phone clamp, sold as a 2-in-1 that converts between tripod and handheld use. Folding legs with flip locks and a rotating head for portrait or landscape.

name: Foldable Metal Tablet Holder with 360° Base
description: One-piece all-metal folding stand with a 360-degree rotating base, stated on the box to suit tablets from 4 to 16 inches. Folds flat to carry and opens without assembly.

name: K007 Pro Vacuum Suction Magnetic Phone Mount
description: Aluminium-alloy magnetic phone mount on a vacuum suction base, for one-handed docking and full multi-angle adjustment. Holds on smooth surfaces such as glass, dashboards and desks.

name: PowerKing P-H32E 30000mAh 22.5W Fast Charge Power Bank
description: Own-brand 30000mAh fast-charge power bank rated 22.5W, with four outputs and a digital percentage display. Two charging cables are built into the body and a wall plug and lead are supplied in the box.

name: PowerKing P-A211 15000mAh 22.5W Fast Charge Power Bank
description: Own-brand 15000mAh fast-charge power bank rated 22.5W with a digital percentage display, two USB-A ports and a USB-C port. The carton lists a smart chip, high-voltage protection and deformation protection.

name: NeePho M21 RGB Pro Lighting Kit
description: Clip-on RGB fill light for phone and camera work, supplied with a fold-out stand bracket and an infrared remote. The box states multiple mode switching, suitable for various scenarios.

name: 300Mbps Wi-Fi Repeater, Access Point and Router
description: Wall-plug 300Mbps wireless range extender that also runs as an access point or a router, with WPS pairing, external antennas and a status LED array. An Ethernet cable is included in the box.

name: PowerKing V35 Good Bass Solar Wireless Speaker
description: Solar-charging wireless speaker with a fold-out FM antenna, in the Good Bass line. Plays from Bluetooth, TF card or USB, and the solar panel tops the battery up outdoors.

name: PowerKing V9 Good Bass Wireless Speaker 8W x2
description: Twin 8W drivers in the Good Bass line, with a moulded slot in the top that stands a phone up for video. Bluetooth, TF card, USB and FM.

name: Kisonli U-2500BT 2.1 USB Gaming Speaker
description: A 2.1 desktop set for gaming — subwoofer with two satellites, Bluetooth, and an infrared remote in the box. USB powered.

name: Kisonli K19 20W Portable Speaker with RGB
description: 20W portable speaker with an RGB light band along the front and a moulded carry handle. Rated for splashes.

name: Kisonli SC-23 10W Speaker with Flashlight
description: 10W portable speaker on a 1800mAh battery, with a built-in flashlight and a folding carry handle.

name: Kisonli KS-1992 Music Portable Speaker
description: Capsule-shaped stereo speaker with a phone stand moulded into the top. Bluetooth, AUX, TF card and USB, with a wrist strap.

name: Kisonli Q2 Mini Music Speaker
description: Compact mains-shaped mini speaker with a top carry handle — the counter-price entry in the Kisonli range.

name: Kisonli B3 Solar Car Music Speaker
description: SUV-shaped novelty speaker with a solar panel in the roof, stereo playback and a built-in flashlight. Sold as a gift line.

name: Kisonli B2 Car Gift Speaker
description: Off-roader-shaped speaker sold as a children\u2019s gift line, with solar charging, stereo playback and a flashlight.

name: LP V78 Good Bass Solar Speaker 10W
description: 10W solar-energy speaker with a 74cm telescopic antenna, side light and removable carry belt. FM radio, TF card and USB on a 1800mAh battery.

name: LP V90 Good Bass Speaker 10W with RGB
description: 10W loud-stereo speaker built around a 4-inch driver, with an RGB light strip and a 74cm telescopic antenna. FM radio, USB, TF card, Type-C, 1800mAh.

name: LP V102 Good Bass Speaker 8W with RGB Ring
description: 8W loud-stereo speaker with a circular RGB ring on the face and a slot that stands a phone up. FM radio, Type-C, USB, TF card, 1200mAh, with a wrist strap.

name: LP V86 Mini Good Bass Speaker 8W
description: 8W loud-stereo mini speaker with an RGB light bar, phone stand and a 74cm telescopic antenna. FM radio, USB, TF card, Type-C, 1800mAh.

name: LP V80 Good Bass Speaker IPX4
description: Compact splash-resistant speaker rated IPX4, with a clip loop for a bag or belt. Photographed alongside the LP V81; separate product shots are still to come.

name: J-iPOK P353 Rugged Portable Speaker
description: Rugged red-and-black portable speaker with a moulded roll cage, top carry handle and a telescopic antenna.

name: J-iPOK P338 Car Bluetooth Speaker
description: Sedan-shaped Bluetooth speaker in the Supre Bass line, with a solar panel under the rear spoiler. A gift and counter-impulse line.

name: WSJAR WS-105 6x6 Car Speaker
description: Six-wheel pickup-shaped Bluetooth speaker with a spare tyre on the bed. Plays from USB devices and TF cards.

name: BOOMSBOX3 Joyous Sound Wireless Speaker
description: Barrel-shaped Hi-Fi speaker with a moulded carry handle, TWS pairing to a second unit, a colour lamp and a 3000mAh battery.

name: NDR High-Power Outdoor Trolley Speaker
description: High-power outdoor cabinet on a stand, supplied with wireless microphones. The box front states big voice, high power and a big battery; no model number is printed on it.

name: DPUS Wooden Cabinet Wireless Speaker
description: Wood-finish cabinet speaker on a stand with a wired microphone input, AUX and USB inputs, FM radio and a remote control. No model number is printed on the unit.

name: Colorful Karaoke Speaker Set with Two Microphones
description: Small karaoke set: one RGB-lit speaker on a leather carry strap with two wireless microphones. The box states a colourful karaoke sound system and carries no model number.

name: V6 Wireless Speaker with Phone Stand
description: Wireless speaker with a fold-up phone stand and a telescopic antenna. The carton is printed only with MODEL: V6 and shows no brand on its face.

name: Kisonli X9BT USB Gaming Speaker with RGB
description: Stereo pair of USB-powered desktop gaming speakers, each with an RGB colour-light ring set into the grille and an in-line volume control on the lead. The carton lists colourful light, stereo sound, USB power and volume control.

name: WSJAR E-8808 8.5" Trolley Speaker with Wireless Mic
description: Trolley speaker with an 8.5-inch driver, rated 8W on the carton, with an LED light field across the front grille and a top control panel. A wireless microphone and a remote are supplied in the box.

name: Kisonli K21 40W Portable Speaker
description: Fabric-wrapped 40W portable speaker with a moulded carry loop, in navy with lime trim. The carton is printed 40W.

name: J-iPOK P378S 10W Solar Car Speaker with Wireless Mic
description: Wireless speaker moulded as an off-road SUV, with a solar panel across the roof and an RGB light bar along the grille. Rated 10W; the carton icon strip shows TF card, USB, TWS pairing and FM radio, and a wireless microphone is supplied.

name: Kisonli K40 20W Outdoor Portable Subwoofer
description: Barrel-body outdoor subwoofer rated 20W, wrapped in mesh fabric with a braided rope carry handle and an RGB-lit passive radiator at one end. The carton is printed "Outdoor Portable Music Subwoofer".

name: Sing-e JQS908S 8" Trolley Speaker
description: Eight-inch multimedia trolley speaker with a pull handle and wheels, printed P.M.P.O 10000W on the carton. A wireless microphone and a remote are supplied. Box marked "HiFi System" and "Super high power".

name: SS-1 8" + 3" Portable Trolley Speaker
description: Portable trolley speaker with an 8-inch woofer and a 3-inch tweeter, printed P.M.P.O 10000W. Supplied with a wired microphone and stand, a wireless microphone, a remote and a manual. The carton carries no brand name — only the model SS-1.

name: J-iPOK P617 8W Solar Speaker with Floodlight
description: Rugged 8W portable speaker with a solar panel let into the top, an LED floodlight at one end and a built-in microphone. Telescopic FM antenna and a USB port on the top panel. Supplied in black, blue and red.

name: Kisonli G24 KTV 16W Party Speaker with Two Microphones
description: KTV party speaker printed 16W P.M.P.O, with two RGB-lit driver rings set into the top panel and two wireless microphones in the box.

name: Kisonli T-004 USB 2.0 Desktop Speaker
description: Compact USB 2.0 desktop speaker pair. The carton states 3W x 2 output, 4 ohm impedance, a 20Hz-20KHz frequency response and a signal-to-noise ratio of 75dB or better.

name: MIGLE YG-A151 Wireless Speaker with Phone Stand
description: Olive-green wireless speaker with a carry handle, a front LED flashlight, a fold-out phone stand and a 740mm telescopic antenna. [CONFIRM MODEL NUMBER — the carton prints it as both YG-A151 and YG-AYS1.]

name: Kisonli K42 15W Portable Speaker
description: Portable 15W speaker on a 2200mAh battery — 3-4 hours to charge, 4-6 hours of play. Bluetooth, TF card, USB and AUX over a 10m range, with TWS pairing, hands-free calling and FM radio. ABS and fabric body, 4 ohm, 100Hz-18KHz, 180 x 95 x 95mm.

name: LP V71 Solar Wireless Speaker 8W x2
description: Solar-charging wireless speaker rated 8W x 2, with Bluetooth 5.3, FM radio, USB playback, TF card, a built-in flashlight and a rechargeable battery. Carry handle and a detachable shoulder strap.

name: Sing-e ZQS8268 Trolley Speaker 20W x2 with Two Microphones
description: Twin 8-inch trolley speaker rated 20W x 2 on a 4500mAh battery, with full-face RGB lighting and two wireless microphones in the box. Carton marked "Super Bass Speaker".

name: SS-10 Twin 10" Trolley Speaker 3000W P.M.P.O
description: Twin 10-inch X.BASS trolley speaker printed 3000W P.M.P.O, with a horn tweeter on top and a full RGB ring around each driver. Two wireless microphones and a remote are supplied; the carton icon strip shows TF card support. The box carries a chevron mark but no readable brand name.

name: Kisonli K27 Portable Wireless Speaker
description: Cylindrical portable wireless speaker in a fabric wrap, with an RGB ring around the front port and a moulded carry loop. Type-C charging, a TF card slot and a DC5V input. Supplied in black and purple.

name: Kisonli A-110 USB 2.0 Desktop Speaker
description: Compact USB 2.0 desktop speaker pair, powered and driven from a single USB lead with an in-line volume control.

name: Sample Portable Bluetooth Speaker 10W
description: Compact 10W Bluetooth speaker with TWS pairing, TF card slot and around 8 hours of playback. A steady counter line for everyday retail.

name: Sample Party Speaker 40W with RGB
description: Large 40W party speaker with RGB lighting, wireless mic input and a rechargeable battery. Sells well through the festival season.

name: Sample Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
description: Foldable over-ear Bluetooth headphones with a built-in mic, AUX fallback and roughly 20 hours of playback per charge.

name: Sample Wired Gaming Headset
description: Wired 3.5mm gaming headset with boom mic and RGB earcups. Popular with gaming and cyber-cafe customers.

name: Sample TWS Wireless Earbuds
description: True wireless earbuds with a charging case, touch controls and a digital battery display. One of the fastest-moving lines in the range.

name: Sample Bluetooth Neckband Earphones
description: Magnetic neckband earphones with around 12 hours of playback, sweat resistance and in-line controls.

name: Sample 20W USB-C Fast Charger
description: Single-port 20W USB-C power delivery wall charger with built-in over-current protection. Supplied in retail-ready boxes.

name: Sample 3-Port Car Charger
description: Dual USB-A plus USB-C car charger with quick-charge support and an LED indicator ring.

name: Sample USB-C Fast Charging Cable 1m
description: Braided 1 metre USB-C to USB-A cable rated for 3A fast charging and data transfer. Supplied in hanging retail packs.

name: Sample Lightning Charging Cable 1m
description: One metre Lightning to USB-A charging and sync cable with a reinforced strain relief collar.

name: Sample 4-Socket Multiplug with USB
description: Four universal sockets plus two USB ports, with a master switch and child-safety shutters.

name: Sample Extension Board 2m Cord
description: Extension board with a 2 metre copper cord, individual switches and surge protection.

name: Sample Magnetic Phone Cooling Fan
description: Magnetic semiconductor phone cooler with RGB lighting and a USB-C feed, for gaming and long recording sessions.

name: Sample 10000mAh Power Bank
description: Slim 10000mAh power bank with dual output, USB-C input and a four-stage LED charge indicator.

name: Sample Adjustable Phone Holder
description: Foldable aluminium desk and car phone holder with an adjustable arm and non-slip pads.
